meaning: to agree with someone about something
literal_translation: concordar totalmente com alguém sobre algo
example: We don't always see eye to eye, but we always find a solution together.
origin: Probably from the idea of two people looking at the same thing from the same point of view; the exact origin is uncertain.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to look at someone very closely
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The eyes are not literal here; the idiom is about having the same opinion, not about looking.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to argue loudly about a problem
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: Arguing is the opposite of agreeing, so this meaning is the reverse of the idiom.
The idiom does not refer to solving problems; it refers to sharing the same view.

explanation: 'See eye to eye' describes two people who share the same opinion or point of view. It is often used in the negative form to say that people disagree.
